# Vendored PyRender

This directory contains PyRender 0.1.45, distributed under the MIT license in
`LICENSE`.  GeoTaichi carries it in-tree: the published package pins an obsolete PyOpenGL release
and its last release predates NumPy 2.

GeoTaichi changes are deliberately limited to compatibility fixes.  The viewer,
trackball, renderer, shaders, and fonts remain PyRender code.
